notes: Softer explicit neoplasm phrasing with tissue recommendation and duct caliber change.

reviewer_focus: Keep softer but still explicit neoplasm suspicion linked to the tissue recommendation.

notes: Subtle contour change and distal duct prominence with occult malignancy not excluded.
report_excerpt: CT pancreas protocol: Mild loss of normal lobulation at the pancreatic neck with distal duct prominence. Impression: occult pancreatic malignancy is not excluded; dedicated pancreas protocol CT is recommended.
reviewer_focus: Surface softer not-excluded wording when it rides with focal pancreatic morphology.

notes: Branch-duct cyst surveillance case with interval septal thickening and a clear MRI follow-up recommendation.
report_excerpt: MRI abdomen: Branch-duct IPMN at the pancreatic body shows mild interval septal thickening without enhancing nodularity. Impression: follow-up pancreas MRI in 6 months is recommended.
reviewer_focus: Keep pancreatic surveillance instructions reviewable even when cancer wording is absent.

notes: Acute-on-chronic pancreatitis with transient duct prominence and an explicit denial of a focal mass.
report_excerpt: CT abdomen: Acute-on-chronic pancreatitis with mild main duct prominence and peripancreatic inflammatory change. No focal pancreatic mass is identified.
reviewer_focus: Avoid turning inflammatory duct prominence into a false alarm when mass language is explicitly denied.

notes: Clean MRI negative control with a normal pancreas and no recommendation language.
report_excerpt: MRI abdomen: Pancreas is normal in contour and signal without ductal dilatation, focal lesion, or cystic change.
reviewer_focus: Keep clean normal surveillance reads out of the queue.

notes: Focal pancreatic head fullness with abrupt side-branch termination and GI workup advice.
report_excerpt: CT abdomen and pelvis: Focal fullness at the pancreatic head with abrupt termination of an adjacent side branch. Impression: an occult pancreatic lesion remains a concern; GI evaluation and endoscopic correlation are recommended.
reviewer_focus: Flag focal fullness plus abrupt ductal change even when the report hedges on naming a mass.

notes: Optional-sounding surveillance recommendation for stable uncinate cyst cluster that is easy to underrank.

reviewer_focus: Make softer optional-sounding surveillance wording visible enough for review.

notes: Incidental fatty pancreatic change without lesion or follow-up recommendation.

reviewer_focus: Do not escalate incidental pancreatic fatty change.

notes: High-acuity neck lesion with malignant process favored and urgent biopsy guidance.
